d: Max Verstappen has never been one to hold back, and his latest war of words with Mercedes driver George Russell has once again put the Formula One world on notice. After their clashes around the Las Vegas Grand Prix, the four-time F1 world champion called Russell an "absolute joke", reigniting a rivalry that has been simmering for years. Rupha Ramani looks at what drives Verstappen's confrontational personality and why the Red Bull star refuses to soften his words.
